the upside. So that's all you need to know right now, even if we end up getting to like 13 cents or even lower, I think this is gonna be a good opportunity. In my opinion, something that will most likely not happen, just because we already got to the oversold territory on the weekly RSI. Someone in the comment section yesterday also mentioned that maybe I'm a bit too bearish right now, because the RSI on the monthly chart, on the Bitcoin chart, is at 43, and in the previous couple of bear markets, Bitcoin always bottomed at an RSI of let's say between 40 and 45 so why am I you know just telling you that we're gonna go lower well because I think that in this bear market Bitcoin is
